content.short: OptimAI Network pays people in OPI for running nodes that collect, check and label data for training AI agents.
content.description: OptimAI Network is a DePIN project with its own EVM layer 2. Anyone can run a node in the browser, on desktop or from the command line. Nodes gather and validate web data, share bandwidth and help with reinforcement learning tasks used to train agents. Verified work earns OPI tokens. The project is backed by YZi Labs and CoinMarketCap. Its products now include OptimAI Search for live context, Claw for execution and Persona agents with memory, and nodes can run as a Chrome extension or a Telegram mini app.
content.meta: Run a node to collect and validate AI training data and earn OPI on OptimAI's layer 2. Explore OptimAI Network on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
